description: This is a Java source file implementing the service layer for handling deposit account operations in a financial application, including activation, deposit, withdrawal, interest calculations, account closure, transfers, charges management, and transaction undo/adjustment for Fixed Deposits and Recurring Deposits.

classes.name: DepositAccountWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of deposit account service handling core operations such as activation, deposits, withdrawals, interest calculations, account closure, transfers, and charges management.

methods.name: activateFDAccount
methods.description: Activates a fixed deposit account, handles related interest and charges, and updates account status.

methods.name: activateRDAccount
methods.description: Activates a recurring deposit account with associated interest calculations and schedule adjustments.

methods.name: depositToFDAccount
methods.description: Processes a deposit transaction into a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: updateDepositAmountForRDAccount
methods.description: Updates the mandatory recommended deposit amount for a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: depositToRDAccount
methods.description: Processes a deposit transaction into a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Performs withdrawal from savings account, with validation and transaction processing.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest on the specified savings account without posting it.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts interest to the savings account, updating transactions and account state.

methods.name: undoFDTransaction
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating FD transaction undo is not allowed.

methods.name: undoRDTransaction
methods.description: Reverses an RD transaction with checks for account status and transfer involvement.

methods.name: adjustFDTransaction
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating FD transaction adjustment is not permitted.

methods.name: adjustRDTransaction
methods.description: Allows adjustment (modification) of an RD transaction, with validation.

methods.name: rejectSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Rejects a savings account transfer by setting its status to on-hold.

methods.name: acceptSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Accepts a savings account transfer, reactivates account, and posts interest.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to a savings account, with validation for due dates and holidays.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates details of an existing savings account charge, with date validations.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a specific charge on a savings account and updates account accordingly.

methods.name: closeFDAccount
methods.description: Closes a fixed deposit account, finalizing the account and optionally adding a note.

methods.name: closeRDAccount
methods.description: Closes a recurring deposit account, finalizing the account and optionally adding a note.

methods.name: prematureCloseFDAccount
methods.description: Prematurely closes a fixed deposit account with validation.

methods.name: prematureCloseRDAccount
methods.description: Prematurely closes a recurring deposit account with validation.

methods.name: initiateSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Initiates transfer process into savings account, setting transaction and account states.

methods.name: withdrawSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Processes withdrawal from a savings transfer, updating transactions and account state.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a specific charge on a savings account, updates account charges accordingly, and performs related interest and transaction validations.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Removes a charge from a savings account and persists the change.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Processes payment of a charge on a savings account, updating transactions, recalculating interest, and ensuring account balance validity.

methods.name: updateMaturityDetails
methods.description: Updates maturity-related details for a deposit account, handling fixed deposit maturity actions and recurrences for recurring deposits.

methods.name: updateExistingTransactionsDetails
methods.description: Collects existing transaction IDs and reversed transaction IDs for a savings account to avoid duplication during updates.

methods.name: postJournalEntries
methods.description: Creates accounting journal entries for a savings account using its derived accounting data.

methods.name: mandatorySavingsAccountDeposit
methods.description: Handles deposit transactions into savings or recurring deposit accounts, including payment detail persistence.
